title: Agent Bootstrap & Canonical State
objective: Replace bootstrap-only state with the permanent multi-track project state and deterministic context-free startup protocol.

tasks.description: Define the permanent project-state schema from the certified ENG-00 baseline.
Implement independent BUSINESS / ENGINEERING / AUDIT tracks.
Define and enforce the permanent state machine and legal transitions.
Migrate the agent startup protocol to the permanent state.
Formalize GitHub-only execution and evidence rules in the permanent engine.
Implement permanent state-drift detection and qualification.

done_when: one permanent machine-readable project state exists
business engineering and audit tracks are independent and unambiguous
fresh agents resolve exactly one authorized task
GitHub-only agents cannot claim unavailable local evidence
external Git drift is detected before work begins
